messages.subject: mid-term evals due
parts:
Dear mentors, mid-term evals are due by Thurs July 18.
Some of you have already submitted evals, thanks!
Submitting your evals is extremely important -- the deadline is hard, and if you do not, then Google may exclude R project from GSOC in the future.
If you need any help, or would like for us admins to do an eval for you, then please send us an email.
Thanks
Toby
